commit.message:
feat(auto-hide): configurable tiers, settings UI, media proxy fixes (#56)

* fix: add BLOSSOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET secrets store binding to worker configs

Media proxy was returning 500 because the binding was missing — the
handler code existed but the secret was never wired in the wrangler
configs. Already hotfixed to staging and prod.

* feat(auto-hide): add config types, DO storage seeding, GET /config endpoint

* feat(auto-hide): add PUT /config endpoint with validation, fix proxy body forwarding

* feat(auto-hide): tier-aware processAutoHide with threshold counting in D1

* feat(auto-hide): add AutoHideSettings UI component in Settings tab

* fix(auto-hide): remove credentials:include from config fetch calls

Auth is header-based (CF Access service tokens), not cookie-based.
credentials:include causes CORS failures when the worker doesn't set
Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true.

* fix: prevent stale onError from marking proxied media as failed

Video elements fire onError from the previous src after React updates
the src to a blob URL. Two fixes:
- key={displayUrl} forces remount so stale error events don't fire
- Guard else branch: don't mark URLs as failed if proxy already succeeded

* fix: recognize QUARANTINE as blocked state, recover from bad proxy blobs

useMediaStatus treated only PERMANENT_BAN as blocked, so QUARANTINE items
(404 on CDN, restricted on Blossom) showed wrong action buttons.

MediaPreview had a dead-end in handleError: if proxy returned HTTP 200
with non-video content, the blob URL was set but unplayable, and the
second onError did nothing because proxyUrls.has(url) was already true.
Now clears the bad blob and falls through to the broken-media icon.

* fix: add CF Access headers to AutoHideSettings, scope threshold count by category

AutoHideSettings fetch calls were bare — no getApiHeaders() — so CF Access
blocks them before the worker sees the request. Would 401 in staging/prod.

countUniqueReporters was not category-scoped, so reports from different
categories (e.g. NS-sexualContent + NS-violence) counted toward each
other's thresholds. Now filters by reason prefix to isolate per-category.

* fix: review follow-ups — blob cleanup, category match, pending review filters

InlineMediaPreview was missing blob URL cleanup on unmount (memory leak).

countUniqueReporters LIKE pattern tightened to exact match + colon prefix
to prevent cross-category collisions if category names share a prefix.

Reports: exclude auto-hide actions from resolved targets so auto-hidden
items appear in the pending review queue. Clear category filter when
toggling pending review on.

* fix: remove misleading INSERT OR IGNORE on auto_hidden decisions

No UNIQUE constraint exists on moderation_decisions, so INSERT OR IGNORE
behaved identically to INSERT INTO. isAlreadyAutoHidden() is the real
deduplication gate.

* fix(types): add QUARANTINE to ModerationAction union

moderation-service D1 stores QUARANTINE as an action value and returns
it from /check-result/{sha256}. The type was missing it, causing TS2367
in useMediaStatus where we check for quarantined media.

* fix: address code review — blob cleanup, shared constants, tier model

- MediaPreview: use ref for blob URL cleanup so revocation only runs on
  unmount, not on every proxyUrls map change (use-after-revoke bug)
- Reports: import AUTO_HIDE_ACTIONS from shared constants instead of
  inline array. Worker has matching constant with cross-reference comment.
- AutoHideSettings + ReportWatcher: use threshold === 1 as the canonical
  discriminant for immediate behavior instead of name-matching "Immediate"
- Peel QUARANTINE type + useMediaStatus change into separate PR
- Peel BLOSSOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET binding into separate PR

* fix(lint): remove unused AUTO_HIDE_ACTIONS constant in ReportWatcher

Action strings are used as literals in SQL/decision logic. Keep the
cross-reference comment so both sides stay in sync.

* fix(auto-hide): unify tier contract and shared actions

* fix(auto-hide): migrate legacy stored configs

---------

Co-authored-by: Liz Sweigart <127434495+NotThatKindOfDrLiz@users.noreply.github.com>

fix: add BLOSSOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET secrets store binding to worker configs (#63)

* fix: add BLOSSOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET secrets store binding to worker configs

Media proxy was returning 500 because the binding was missing — the
handler code existed but the secret was never wired in the wrangler
configs. Already hotfixed to staging and prod.

* docs: align Blossom proxy docs and local setup

commit.message:
fix: recognize QUARANTINE as blocked state in media status (#62)

* fix: recognize QUARANTINE as blocked state in media status

moderation-service D1 stores QUARANTINE as an action value and returns
it from /check-result/{sha256}. The type was missing it, causing TS2367
in useMediaStatus where we check for quarantined media. QUARANTINE items
(404 on CDN, restricted on Blossom) now show correct action buttons.

* fix: split media status action from moderation request action

---------

Co-authored-by: Liz Sweigart <127434495+NotThatKindOfDrLiz@users.noreply.github.com>
